Parse quoted Jinja variables in SQL text without recovery

```python title="Python"
from tree_sitter_language_pack import process

def main() -> None:
    source = "CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)\nPARTITIONED BY (`p` string)\nROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'\nSTORED AS INPUTFORMAT 'x' OUTPUTFORMAT 'y'\nLOCATION 's3://{{bucket}}/t/'\nTBLPROPERTIES ('k'='v');"
    config = {"language": "jinja2"}
    result = process(source, config)
    print(result.language)
    print(result.metrics.error_count)
    print(result.metrics.total_bytes)

main()
```
